attempts.response:
WITH infra AS (
  SELECT "School Code", "Block", "Electricity"
  FROM "school_infrastructure"
  WHERE "Electricity" = 'No'
),
enrolment AS (
  SELECT "School Code", "Block",
         SUM("Girls 2024") AS "Girls 2024",
         SUM("Boys 2024") AS "Boys 2024"
  FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
  GROUP BY "School Code", "Block"
)
SELECT i."Block", COUNT(DISTINCT i."School Code") AS "School Count",
       SUM(e."Girls 2024") AS "Total Girls 2024",
       SUM(e."Boys 2024") AS "Total Boys 2024"
FROM infra i
JOIN enrolment e ON i."School Code" = e."School Code"
GROUP BY i."Block"
ORDER BY i."Block";
